sex.evidence: Homozygous mtDNA mutator (PolgA mut/mut) mice (N = 8 males, N = 8 females) and “wild‐type” (PolgA wt/wt) nDNAwt/mtDNAmut littermates (N = 8 males, N = 8 females) that have a wild‐type nuclear genome but maternally inherited mtDNA mutations (Ross et al., 2014, 2013), herein referred to as WT mice, were obtained by crossing mice heterozygous (PolgA WT/mut) for the mtDNA mutator allele.
